top_signal.title: Srruggling with burnout, any advice?
top_signal.summary: I’ve been struggling pretty badly with burnout lately, and I’m wondering how other small business owners/ ppl deal with it without completely losing their love for what they do. I run a small business making and painting 3D figures. I’ve been doing this for about two years, and I genuinely love creating. I started it so i coild work and be a live in caretaker, Painting is one of the things that makes me happiest, and I’ve put a ridiculous amount of time, money, effort, and emotion into building what I have and without it id feel like im not contributing to society..    The problem is that lately I feel like I’m being pulled in a million different directions, and the business is only one part of it. Outside of work, I’m also a caregiver for my elderly grandfather, who I live with. I love him more than anything but he is incredibly ungrateful and can be so mean at times, and I don’t regret taking care of him, but caregiving is still a responsibility that never really switches off. I didn't get to go to college, bec I needed to be there for him, ( and now my scholarship timed out) so a lot of my life revolves around making sure things at home are taken care of while also trying to build something for myself.   I’m also hard of hearing, and I deal with FASD and anxiety, so sometimes things that might seem simple to other people can take a lot more mental energy for me.
